name: Claude Sessions
author: Mike
description: Live status of every Claude Code session on this machine: working, watching a background task, or waiting on you.

barWidget.description: One icon that shows whether Claude Code is working or needs you, and a panel listing every session. Pick one to jump to its window.

schema.label: Notify when a session needs you
schema.description: Unfocused notifies only when that session's window isn't the one you're looking at.
